b9c8539f729c707e.description:
We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Databricks Engineer to contribute to the engineering, modernization, and continuous evolution of data processing platform on Databricks on AWS. While supporting the transition from the legacy Cloudera Hadoop platform to Databricks on AWS, this role will continue to play a key part in enhancing performance, simplifying pipelines, and delivering new capabilities on the Databricks platform over the long term.

The ideal candidate is a strong hands‑on Spark engineer with solid design experience, capable of contributing to architectural decisions while leading complex implementation and optimization efforts.

Responsibilities:

• Platform Engineering & Modernization
• Refactor and modernize existing Spark pipelines to Databricks native architectures
• Eliminate legacy Hadoop dependencies and adopt cloud native AWS patterns
• Enhance and extend existing processing logic using optimized Spark (JavaSpark / PySpark) on Databricks
• Databricks Native Development
• Build and optimize solutions using Databricks features, including Delta Lake, Databricks Workflows for orchestration and Auto scaling and job clusters
• Design & Solution Engineering
• Contribute to low and mid level architecture and design
• Translate high level architecture into detailed technical designs
• Define data models, pipeline patterns, and reusable components
• Ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, and production ready
• Performance Optimization & Simplification
• Analyze, improve Spark job performance and simplify complex or over engineered pipelines into standardized, efficient patterns
• Engineering Standards & Best Practices
• Follow and contribute to Databricks and Spark engineering standards
• Write clean, modular, and testable code
• Contribute to shared frameworks, reusable libraries, and quality standards
• Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement
• Work closely with senior architects, platform teams, and DevOps engineers
• Provide technical inputs, troubleshooting support, and implementation guidance
• Participate in design discussions and technical decision making
• Testing & Quality Assurance
• Develop unit, integration, and data validation tests
• Support production releases and post deployment validation

Qualifications:

Core Technical Skills

• 11+ years in data engineering or distributed systems
• Strong expertise in Apache Spark (JavaSpark / PySpark), Databricks on AWS, and Delta Lake
• Experience on SQL
• Experience with AWS services and large‑scale distributed data processing

Modernization & Optimization Experience

• Experience modernizing or refactoring legacy data platforms into cloud‑based architectures
• Strong background in Spark performance tuning and large‑scale batch optimization

Design Capability

• Ability to translate architecture into implementable designs
• Understanding of data modeling and pipeline orchestration patterns

Behavioral Competencies

• Strong problem‑solving mindset for complex distributed systems
• Comfortable working in time‑bound, high‑impact environments
• Proactive, accountable, and collaborative
• Clear communication skills across global teams

Education:

• Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience

b99bebd80e9b1445.description: About Reputation Reputation, founded in Silicon Valley in 2013, is the industry's sole platform that uses an AI-powered product stack to help companies measure, manage, and scale their real-time reputation performance everywhere, effectively functioning as a business's eyes and ears across all customer feedback channels to uncover predictive insights. This market leadership is reinforced by significant funding from top-tier firms like Bessemer Venture Partner, Kleiner Perkins, and Marlin Equity Partners, driving substantial annual recurring revenue from Global Fortune 1000 companies, major automotive OEMs, healthcare systems, and top property management firms, with trust from over 250 partners including Google and Meta. Recognized recently as Americas Greatest Midsized Workplaces by Newsweek which rewards excellence and career development, and attracts player-coaches, team-oriented collaborators, and individuals who value perseverance and hustle. Job Summary : Reputation is seeking a Go Backend Engineer with PERN Stack experience to maintain and contribute to a large ecosystem of production microservices and web services running on GCP. In this role, you will keep services healthy, resolve issues, and deliver new features across a well-established distributed platform. While Go is the primary language, the platform also includes a PERN stack (PostgreSQL, Express, React, Node.js), and you will be expected to work comfortably across both. We are looking for engineers who can build simple, fast, and scalable software in a fast-paced environment. Responsibilities: Maintain and enhance existing Go microservices across a distributed, event-driven platform. Contribute to Node.js/Express and GraphQL API services as needed. Support and maintain React (Class Components) frontend applications when required. Contribute to new feature development based on product and business requirements. Manage and update Helm charts for deployments across Stage, Production, and EU environments. Maintain and improve GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines. Troubleshoot and resolve production incidents across services. Write and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests (using Testify and testcontainers-go). Participate in code reviews and uphold code quality standards. Collaborate with DevOps and platform teams on infrastructure-related changes. Additional duties as assigned. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience). 2+ years of hands-on Go (Golang) development experience in a production environment, with exposure to Node.js/Express and React. Strong understanding of microservices architecture, distributed systems patterns, and experience working in a large microservices ecosystem (50+ services). Proficiency with Kubernetes and Helm writing and managing Helm charts for multi-environment deployments. Hands-on experience with GitHub Actions for CI/CD workflows including build, test, and deploy pipelines. Experience with GCP services, particularly Pub/Sub for event-driven messaging, and RabbitMQ (AMQP) for message queue management. Solid experience with PostgreSQL (including ORM usage via GORM/pgx) and Redis. Familiarity with Elasticsearch (indexing, querying, and percolation patterns). Experience with Docker and containerized application development. Familiarity with structured logging, health checks, Prometheus metrics instrumentation, and observability tools (OpenTelemetry). Experience with Node.js, Express.js, and GraphQL (schema design, resolvers, API integration). Familiarity with React (specifically Class Components) for maintaining existing frontend applications. Exposure to AWS Redshift or data warehouse integrations, multi-region cloud deployments (US + EU on GCP), and Terraform for infrastructure-as-code. Strong problem-solving skills, excellent written and verbal communication, and ability to work independently in a distributed team. Our Benefits & Perks We believe our people deserve to feel supported, valued, and rewarded both in and out of work. Thats why we offer a generous and thoughtfully designed benefits package, including: Health Insurance & Wellness Benefits: Group Health Insurance: Medical Insurance with floater policy of up to Rs 10,00,000 for employee + spouse + 2 dependent children + 2 parents / parent-in-laws Maternity Benefits: Medical insurance up to 75,000 INR, 26 weeks of leave for birth, adoption or surrogacy Life Insurance: Insurance at 3x annual cost to the company (Term Insurance, GPA) Accident/Disability Insurance: Insured at 3x base salary for permanent total disability, permanent partial disability and temporary total disability (GPA) OPD: As part of your health benefits, Employees are entitled to an annual OPD allowance of 7,500. This can be used for doctor consultations, diagnostic tests, and prescribed medications. The benefit is applicable to both the employee and eligible

b9ee744c90167dcd.description:
Headquarters: Remote
 
URL: https://ondeckglobal.com/

About the Role

We are looking for a talented and detail-oriented UI/UX Designer with a strong understanding of the iGaming industry to create engaging, intuitive, and visually compelling digital experiences.
You will be responsible for designing user-focused interfaces across online casino, sportsbook, betting, and gaming platforms, working closely with product managers, developers, and other stakeholders to transform product requirements into seamless player experiences.
The ideal candidate combines strong visual design skills with UX thinking and understands how to design interfaces that are engaging, responsive, conversion-focused, and easy to navigate.

Key Responsibilities

• Design modern, high-quality UI/UX for iGaming websites, web apps, and mobile experiences.

• Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity interfaces in Figma.

• Design key iGaming experiences such as casino lobbies, sportsbook interfaces, game discovery, promotions, tournaments, loyalty/VIP areas, registration, deposits, and withdrawals.

• Improve player journeys with a focus on usability, engagement, retention, and conversion.

• Build and maintain scalable design systems, UI components, typography, iconography, and reusable design patterns.

• Create responsive designs that deliver a consistent experience across desktop, tablet, and mobile.

• Collaborate closely with Product, Development, Marketing, CRM, and other teams from concept through implementation.

• Work with developers to ensure accurate implementation and maintain high visual quality.

• Use research, analytics, user feedback, and product insights to identify UX improvements.

• Continuously improve existing interfaces through iteration, testing, and optimization.

• Stay current with iGaming design trends, competitor products, UX best practices, and emerging technologies.

• Design with accessibility, responsible gaming principles, and market-specific requirements in mind.

Required Skills & Experience

• 7+ years of UI/UX or Product Design experience, preferably within iGaming, gaming, fintech, entertainment, or another fast-paced digital product environment.

• Strong portfolio demonstrating polished UI design and thoughtful UX problem-solving.

• Advanced proficiency in Figma, including components, variants, Auto Layout, prototyping, and design systems.

• Strong understanding of responsive and mobile-first design.

• Excellent knowledge of typography, spacing, grids, color, hierarchy, and interaction design.

• Experience translating complex product requirements into simple, intuitive user experiences.

• Good understanding of user journeys, conversion funnels, and usability principles.

• Ability to collaborate effectively with developers and understand technical constraints.

• Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain consistency across large products.

• Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-moving environment.

iGaming Experience — Strong Advantage

Experience designing any of the following will be highly valued:

• Online Casino & Live Casino

• Sportsbook & Sports Betting

• Slots and Game Lobbies

• Registration & KYC flows

• Deposits, Withdrawals & Payment UX

• Bonuses & Promotions

• VIP & Loyalty Programs

• Tournaments & Gamification

• Player Account & Wallet Experiences

• CRM and Retention Experiences

• Multi-brand or White-label Gaming Platforms

Nice to Have

• Experience with A/B testing and conversion optimization.

• Understanding of HTML/CSS and front-end development principles.

• Experience working with analytics and behavioral tools.

• Experience designing gamification and reward mechanics.

• Motion design or micro-interaction experience.

• Experience working with international or multi-market products.

• Familiarity with accessibility standards and responsible gaming UX.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for more than someone who can make screens look good.
You should be able to understand player behavior, business objectives, and product requirements, then turn them into experiences that are intuitive, engaging, and commercially effective.
You care about the details, challenge weak UX, communicate your design decisions clearly, and enjoy building digital products that players genuinely enjoy using.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ondeckglobal-igaming-ui-ux-designer
